newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Malbak's Kohler cautions over talks.
newsitem.headline: Malbak's Kohler cautions over talks.

text.p: Packaging group Kohler Ltd cautioned shareholders on Friday that it was in talks that could have an impact on its share price.
It gave no further details in a brief statement which follows intense speculation this week about the future of its parent Malbak Ltd.

The Rembrandt Group (Remgro) is rumoured to be keen to buy Malbak in which it already holds a stake, though Remgro managing director Thys Visser told Reuters on Thursday that it had made no decisions regarding its investment in the company.
Malbak recently underwent a rigorous unbundling exercise which has left it as a focused packaging company.
The unbundling saw Malbak sell off its unlisted assets and distribute the shares in its underlying listed subsidiaries to shareholders.
Malbak's primary assets since the unbundling are a 68 percent stake in Kohler Ltd and a 64 percent interest in UK-listed MY Holdings Plc.
